ACC-5001.name: JournalNotBalanced
ACC-5001.message: Journal entry debit and credit totals must balance.
ACC-5001.hint: Adjust the lines so total debit equals total credit.

ACC-5002.name: JournalTooFewLines
ACC-5002.message: A journal entry requires at least two lines.

ACC-5003.name: JournalZeroAmount
ACC-5003.message: A journal entry must have a non-zero amount.

ACC-5004.name: JournalPostingFailed
ACC-5004.message: The journal entry could not be posted.

ACC-5005.name: JournalEntryNotEditable
ACC-5005.message: Only a draft journal entry can be edited. Posted and reversed entries are immutable.
ACC-5005.hint: Reverse the entry and create a corrected one instead.

ACC-5006.name: CreditLimitExceeded
ACC-5006.message: Posting this document would exceed the party credit limit. Limit: {0}; current balance: {1}; document total: {2}.
ACC-5006.hint: Collect a payment, raise the credit limit on the party card, or reduce the document total.

ACC-5007.name: CostCenterAllocationInvalid
ACC-5007.message: The allocation for cost center '{0}' is invalid: its percentages must total 100 and every target must be an active leaf cost center.
ACC-5007.hint: Fix the allocation on the cost center card and post again.

ACC-5008.name: CostCenterNotLeaf
ACC-5008.message: Cost center '{0}' is a group or inactive cost center and cannot receive postings.
ACC-5008.hint: Choose an active leaf cost center, or define an allocation for the group center.

ACC-5009.name: CostCenterUnknown
ACC-5009.message: Cost center '{0}' does not match any active cost center for this company and cannot be posted.
ACC-5009.hint: Create the cost center or correct the code, then post again.

ACC-5010.name: CostCenterRequired
ACC-5010.message: Account '{0}' requires a cost center; the journal line has none.
ACC-5010.hint: Add a cost center to the line, or clear the cost-required flag on the account card.

ACC-5011.name: DocumentPostingAccountMissing
ACC-5011.message: Document posting account '{0}' is missing, inactive, deleted, or not postable for this company.
ACC-5011.hint: Create or activate a postable account with that code in the chart of accounts, then post again.

ACC-5012.name: DocumentAlreadyPostedToGl
ACC-5012.message: Document '{0}' already has a posted general-ledger entry and cannot be posted twice.
ACC-5012.hint: Reverse the existing journal entry before posting the document again.

ACC-5013.name: DocumentTotalMismatch
ACC-5013.message: Document '{0}' stored total {1} does not match the total recomputed from its lines ({2}); posting uses the stored total.
ACC-5013.hint: Check the document's header discount and extra charges; correct the stored document if the stored total is wrong.

ACC-5014.name: DocumentKindNotPostable
ACC-5014.message: Document kind '{0}' cannot be posted through the invoice posting path.
ACC-5014.hint: Use the dedicated window for this document kind (stock transfers and stock counts post through the warehouse engines), or check the document kind.

AUTH-2001.name: InvalidCredentials
AUTH-2001.message: The username or password is incorrect
AUTH-2001.hint: Check the username and password and try again.

AUTH-2002.name: AccountLocked
AUTH-2002.message: This account is locked. Sign-in was refused.
AUTH-2002.hint: Wait until the lockout period ends or ask an administrator to unlock the account.

AUTH-2003.name: AccountLockedNow
AUTH-2003.message: The account was locked after repeated failed sign-in attempts.
AUTH-2003.hint: Wait until the lockout period ends or ask an administrator to unlock the account.

AUTH-2004.name: PasswordPolicyViolation
AUTH-2004.message: Administrator password does not meet the password policy: {0}
AUTH-2004.hint: Use at least 12 characters with a mix of letters, digits, and a symbol.

AUTH-2005.name: PermissionDenied
AUTH-2005.message: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
AUTH-2005.hint: Ask an administrator to grant the required permission.

AUTH-2006.name: PermissionLoadFailed
AUTH-2006.message: The signed-in user's permissions could not be loaded.
AUTH-2006.hint: Sign in again; if the problem persists, check the company database.

CO-3001.name: CompanyRecordNotFound
CO-3001.message: The local company record required to open this company was not found.
CO-3001.hint: The company list on this computer is out of date. Reindex companies or restore the company data.

CO-3002.name: CompanyDatabasePathMissing
CO-3002.message: Company database path is not set.
CO-3002.hint: Edit the company and set its database path.

CO-3003.name: PostgresDatabaseNameMissing
CO-3003.message: PostgreSQL database name is not set.

CO-3004.name: PostgresConnectionMissing
CO-3004.message: Current PostgreSQL connection is not available.

CO-3007.name: CompanyCoaTemplateNotFound
CO-3007.message: The selected chart of accounts template could not be found.
CO-3007.hint: Pick another chart of accounts template, or restore the template files in the Resources/COA folder.

DATA-4001.name: ExportPermissionDenied
DATA-4001.message: You do not have permission to export data (DATA.EXPORT).
DATA-4001.hint: Ask an administrator to grant the DATA.EXPORT permission.

DATA-4002.name: ExportFailed
DATA-4002.message: The export could not be completed.

DATA-4003.name: ImportFailed
DATA-4003.message: The import could not be completed.

DB-1001.name: DatabaseConnectionFailed
DB-1001.message: Could not connect to the database.
DB-1001.hint: Check that the database server is running and the connection settings are correct.

DB-1002.name: DatabaseFileMissing
DB-1002.hint: The company database file may have been moved or deleted. Restore it from a backup or re-create the company.

DB-1004.name: DatabaseNotInitialized
DB-1004.message: Company database file is not properly initialized.
DB-1004.hint: The file exists but is not a valid company database. Restore from a backup or re-create the company.

INV-6001.name: InventoryOperationFailed
INV-6001.message: The inventory operation could not be completed.

LIC-8001.name: LicenseCheckFailed
LIC-8001.message: The license could not be verified.

SYS-0001.name: UnknownError
SYS-0001.hint: If the problem continues, note the error code and contact support.

SYS-0002.name: DispatcherUnhandled
SYS-0002.message: An unexpected error interrupted the current operation.
SYS-0002.hint: If the problem continues, note the error code and contact support.

SYS-0003.name: AppDomainUnhandled
SYS-0003.message: An unexpected error occurred in the application.

SYS-0005.name: NonFatalInternalFailure
SYS-0005.message: A non-critical internal operation failed and was recovered.

SYS-0006.name: ConfigurationLoadFailed
SYS-0006.message: The application configuration could not be loaded.

SYS-0007.name: FileAccessFailed
SYS-0007.message: A file could not be accessed.

SYS-0010.name: SettingsLoadFailed
SYS-0010.message: Settings could not be loaded; defaults were used.

UI-7001.name: WindowOperationFailed
UI-7001.message: The window operation could not be completed.

UI-7002.name: ShellOperationFailed
UI-7002.message: A main window operation could not be completed.

UI-7003.name: WindowLoadFailed
UI-7003.message: The window could not be loaded.
